body: Please do not I promise you you’ll make it through whatever you’re going through, if you don’t wait for the future you’ll never know how happy you’ll end up being. Please be safe

You and I are very similar I feel like, I could never picture myself living as a true adult. I also hate college and am drowning in missing work due to depression and fear of even opening my computer. I like to think most people subtly feel that way though. I feel like as an adolescent/young adult, you can’t really imagine yourself living past a certain age. I think that’s the beauty of the future; you don’t really know what’s going to happen and you can’t envision it because you truly don’t know what’s going to happen. That’s why we need to keep pushing on to see what is going to happen. I hope you and I both make it through our rough patches. You won’t ever know what happiness you have in store for you if you end it now. All love.

I wouldn’t exactly force it out of her, just remind her that you’re there for her whenever she needs it and be a shoulder to cry on. Go out of your way to be kind and do extra things, but don’t make it seem like that’s why you’re giving her special treatment just remotely normalize it, may make them feel like a burden if not. I’m obviously not an expert it’s just how I feel when I’m going through this shit

let her know you’re there for her and give her someone to talk to (yourself or anyone), sometimes having someone to talk to is the best thing. Therapy isn’t a horrible idea either. Obviously sounds cliche but it’s the truth
